title: Custom Hooks Architecture
description: Design scalable custom hook libraries with proper state management, composition, and testing strategies.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to design, implement, and organize custom hooks for maximum reusability and maintainability. You will learn hook composition patterns, state sharing between hooks, dependency management, error handling in hooks, and how to build a coherent custom hook library for your team or organization.
whatYouLearn: Compose multiple hooks together to build complex stateful logic
Share state between hooks using refs, contexts, and external stores
Handle loading, error, and success states gracefully in custom hooks
Design and document a custom hook library for team use
